text: Post-training quantization of neural-network weights to INT8 typically costs more than 10% of classification accuracy, which is why photonic inference is impractical.
explanation: False: post-training quantization to INT8 typically costs under 1% accuracy, and 6-8 effective bits suffice for classification. This low-precision tolerance is precisely what matches photonic hardware's 4-9 ENOB and makes photonic inference workable; the claim inverts the small real accuracy cost.
